title: #86 – David Silver: AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: David Silver leads the reinforcement learning research group at DeepMind and was lead researcher on AlphaGo, AlphaZero and co-lead on AlphaStar, and MuZero and lot of important work in reinforcement learning.
